description: A copy owed for a later transmission is dropped when that transmission could not end within the reception window already announced.
note: As dts-nonarq/repeats-across-transmissions up to the end of the first transmission (35550): its copy announced a reception window ending at 71600 (C-0350, C-1051; window 82 since corpus 0.37.0, interp C-1292, 57 ending at 59100 before). Another station's burst then holds the channel from 36000 to 60000 (no D_PDU decoded); the LBT timer is cancelled while busy and restarted with lbt_wait_dcd_ms 30000 when the channel is idle (K-0077, K-0087). At 90000 the contention wait is 0, and on entry to LINKING the DTS finds that a transmission starting now cannot end by 71600 (90000 + 5550 = 95550), so the two copies still owed are dropped, not sent (C-0353, C-1052), with no rejection: the TTL has not expired and non-ARQ has no confirmation. That empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled and the MAC returns to SENSE with no transmission (K-0091, core-architecture.md 3.5 rule 4).
